title: Sentinel satellite analysis of Cyclone Gabrielle flooding near Napier, 2023
sourceName: Wikimedia Commons, originally published by Pierre Markuse
credit: Pierre Markuse; contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data [2023]. Source material distributed via Wikimedia Commons under CC BY 2.0; WebP versions resized without cropping.
altText: Satellite radar visualisation of flooding around Napier in Hawke's Bay during Cyclone Gabrielle in February 2023.
caption: Copernicus Sentinel data processed by Pierre Markuse, showing flooding near Napier during Cyclone Gabrielle in February 2023. The image illustrates observed flood extent and is not an NZTA operational GIS screenshot.
dateDisplay: 15 February 2023 (processed satellite image; depicts February 2023 flooding)
context: Image depicts the actual 2023 cyclone flooding relevant to the emergency period. It does not document the content, software or results of the NZTA operational platform discussed in the linked historical event.
